preconditions.description: The number of blocks in string t is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.
The number of blocks in string s is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l_i <= 1000000 for l_i, c_i in t_blocks)
preconditions.description: Each block length in t is between 1 and 1,000,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l_i <= 1000000 for l_i, c_i in s_blocks)
preconditions.description: Each block length in s is between 1 and 1,000,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c_i in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for l_i, c_i in t_blocks)
preconditions.description: Each character in t is a lowercase English letter.

preconditions.expression: all(c_i in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for l_i, c_i in s_blocks)
preconditions.description: Each character in s is a lowercase English letter.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for start in range(len(t)) if t[start:start+len(s)] == s)
postconditions.description: The return value is the number of occurrences of s in t.
